class.name: KilnGIWorld
class.brief_description: Native Kiln diffuse illumination with hardware tracing and software fallback.
class.description: Captures rigid MeshInstance3D geometry and local lights from the parent subtree for the Kiln renderer. Set kiln_dynamic metadata on moving geometry and kiln_exclude on auxiliary geometry. Static and dynamic geometry/resource changes are detected automatically. Imported models automatically store a KilnGIProxy resource. Solid textured materials use simplified geometry and linear average reflectance/emission proxies; material edits refresh the proxy automatically. Runtime-generated meshes retain automatic lazy proxy generation. Low-level GPU-only geometry changes require rebuild(). This experimental API is specific to the Kiln engine fork.

method.name: set_query_backend
method.description: Selects 0 (automatic hardware ray query with software fallback, default), 1 (force compute software BVH), or 2 (prefer hardware, with fallback on unsupported devices). Both backends use the same proxy triangles, materials and GI integration. Changing this setting resets lighting history.

method.name: set_resolution_divisor
method.description: Sets GI receiver spacing to 2 (quality, default) or 4 (balanced). Full-resolution geometry guides reconstruction. Changing this value reallocates GI history; raster and AO resolution are unchanged.

method.name: set_proxy_quality
method.description: Sets the target triangle ratio (0.01–1) and maximum relative geometric error (0–0.05). Defaults are 0.12 and 0.001. Open boundaries and the error bound take precedence over the ratio. Changing quality invalidates cached proxies.

method.name: set_quality
method.description: Sets 1-8 stationary rays per frame and 16-1024 convergence samples. Lighting changes use at least four rays per frame. Quality changes reset history.

method.name: validate_bvh
method.description: Compares packed-BVH nearest intersections against brute-force triangles using deterministic rays. Diagnostic only; expensive on large worlds.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns geometry/light versions, uploaded light counts, overflow diagnostics and optional frame profile data. Unavailable GPU times are null.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds static and dynamic geometry and clears mesh-array caches.

method.name: request_capture
method.description: Requests raw diagnostic texture readback to a directory. Synchronous GPU readbacks must not be used during benchmark measurements.

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Rejects temporal and world-cache history without rebuilding geometry.

method.name: set_ao_enabled
method.description: Controls XeGTAO independently of indirect light tracing.

method.name: set_lighting
method.description: Supplies the direction toward the sun, linear color, energies and normalized time of day.

method.name: set_profiling
method.description: Enables engine frame timestamp collection. GPU availability depends on the active device driver.

method.name: set_sky
method.description: Selects shared procedural sky radiance or the original reference sky model using linear horizon and zenith colors.

members.member: Environment associated with this illumination world.
